m: अप-जात m. a bad son who has turned out ill, Pañcat.
a: अपजातः — A bad son who has turned out ill; one inferior to his parents in qualities; मातृतुल्यगुणो जातस्त्वनुजातः पितुः समः . अतिजातोधिकस्तस्मादपजातोऽधमाधमः ..

m: अप-√ ज्ञा -जानीते, to dissemble, conceal, Pāṇ. i, 3, 44.
a: अपज्ञा — {c9c} A. To deny, disown, repudiate, dissemble, conceal; शतमपजानीते P. I. 3. 44 Sk. ( अपलपति); आत्मानमपजानानः शशमात्रोऽनयद्दिनं Bk. 8. 26 concealing himself.

a: अपजर्गुराण — a. (अपगॄ-यङ्लुक् चानश्) Ved. Accustomed to take off or remove the covering &c. ( आच्छादनादिमोचनशील) Rv. 5. 29. 4.

m: अप-√ जि to ward off, keep off or out, ŚBr.; Kāṭh.; PBr.
to win from (with पुनः, ‘to reconquer’), TS.
a: अपजि — {c1c} P. To defeat, conquer; turn off or away, avert, ward or keep off; येन मृत्युमपजयति Śat. Br.

m: अप-जिघांसु mfn. (√ हन् Desid.), desirous of keeping off, wishing to avert, AitBr.
अप-जिहीर्षा f. the wish to take away, Kathās.
अप-जिहीर्षु mfn. (√ हृ Desid.), wishing to carry off or take away, Rājat.
अपज्वर mfn. free from fever, MBh.
अप-ज्य mfn. without a bowstring, MBh.
